observed_behavior: HTTP GET /health hangs and times out (>120s) with 0 bytes received at Render edge proxy (216.24.57.15).
diagnosed_root_cause: Obsolete blueprint binding: render.yaml declares fromDatabase: name: otravelz-db which was retired on 2026-09-04 when PostgreSQL was migrated to Aiven Cloud.
Render free-tier database expiration: otravelz-db was deleted by Render after 30 days, causing the service build/start sequence to fail due to missing or invalid DATABASE_URL.
Service hibernation/suspension: Inactivity or crash-looping during startup (alembic migration attempt) caused Render to mark the web service suspended.
Control-plane boundary: No Render API tokens or CLI credentials exist in this local or CI environment; human dashboard access is required to un-suspend.

operator_action_checklist.title: Log into Render Dashboard
operator_action_checklist.action: Navigate to https://dashboard.render.com and sign in.

operator_action_checklist.title: Locate Web Service
operator_action_checklist.action: Click on the web service named otravelz-backend. If it is listed as Suspended, click Resume Web Service.

operator_action_checklist.title: Update Environment Variables
operator_action_checklist.action: Go to the Environment tab of otravelz-backend. Verify/set the following environment variables: DATABASE_URL (set to the approved Aiven PostgreSQL connection URI with sslmode=require), ENVIRONMENT=production, CORS_ORIGINS=https://algoryxz.github.io,https://otravelz.in,https://www.otravelz.in,http://localhost:5173, STORAGE_BACKEND=local, LOCAL_STORAGE_BASE_PATH=./data/images.

operator_action_checklist.title: Deploy Latest Commit
operator_action_checklist.action: Go to the Manual Deploy dropdown and click Deploy latest commit from branch feature/v4-platform-rebuild (or main once merged).

operator_action_checklist.title: Verify Live Logs & Health
operator_action_checklist.action: Watch the deployment logs. Confirm alembic upgrade head succeeds (reporting 0020_transit_ride_observations), database verification succeeds, Uvicorn starts on port 8000, and curl -i https://otravelz-backend.onrender.com/health returns HTTP 200 OK.
